story.title: Carney Seeks European Alliance Amid US Trade Tensions
story.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney is visiting Europe to explore a 'unique alliance' with the EU as relations with the US deteriorate. He is also hosting a global investment summit aimed at positioning Canada as a 'safe harbour' for international finance during the ongoing trade war with the United States.

revisions.title: Trump Signs Executive Order to Rename Lake Ontario Amid Trade Dispute with Canada
revisions.summary: President Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America' in the United States. This move is part of escalating tensions in a trade dispute with Canada. The order directs federal agencies to implement the name change on US maps and documents, although it does not affect the Canadian portion of the lake, which Canada has rejected.

event_overview.title: About US-Canada Trade Relations
event_overview.subject: US-Canada Trade Relations
event_overview.summary: U.S.-Canada trade relations are a major bilateral economic relationship shaped by closely integrated supply chains and by the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement (CUSMA/USMCA), the three-country trade pact that replaced NAFTA in 2020. The 2026 trade tensions and negotiations occurred alongside the agreement's first scheduled joint review, while the two governments also used tariff measures and countermeasures affecting particular imports.

facts.label: Governing framework
facts.value: CUSMA/USMCA is the binding trade agreement among Canada, the United States and Mexico; it entered into force on July 1, 2020 and succeeded NAFTA.

facts.label: 2026 review
facts.value: The first mandatory CUSMA/USMCA Joint Review was due on July 1, 2026, six years after entry into force. It is a review of the agreement's operation, not an expiration date, and involves all three parties.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline focuses on the August 2026 escalation in U.S.-Canada tariff actions and political rhetoric; it does not provide a complete history of the bilateral relationship, every tariff measure, or the full trilateral CUSMA/USMCA review process.

related_stories.summary: Donald Trump Jr. and his wife, Bettina Trump, confirmed that their wedding festivities in the Bahamas were partially funded by Umar Kremlev, a Russian oligarch with ties to President Putin. The couple described this support as an 'extremely generous wedding gift from a friend' and expressed gratitude for the two nights of celebrations hosted by Kremlev.

related_stories.title: Supreme Court Rejects Trump's Mail Voting Restrictions, Sparks His Criticism
related_stories.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has rejected efforts by Donald Trump to impose new restrictions on mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections. This ruling allows states to continue using existing mail voting procedures. Following the decision, Trump criticized the court and specifically called out Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas for their dissenting opinions.
